name: hasht-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for the self-hosted chat app — thin client, loads a user-configured server URL.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.json -w" "wait-on dist/main/main.js && electron dist/main/main.js"
scripts.dist:store: npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64 --config electron-builder.store.yml --publish never

author: Hasht LLC
